robot: Franka Panda arm with long fin-ray fingers (a binary parallel gripper) on a fixed base at a table (ManiGuard on OmniGibson)

frame.suite: the scene's world frame: z up, the floor is the plane z = 0; poses are position + quaternion XYZW
frame.base_text: the robot base frame: the arm's root link (panda_link0, the base pose in describe_robot's spec_file robot_spec.base.pose), +X the way the arm faces, +Y to its left, +Z up

arm.note: 7 joints (panda_joint1..7, rad); a binary gripper (any value of 0.5 or more closes it); end-effector pose = the fingertip centre

ee.mode_text: the service solves each pose by the arm's IK (no collision checking) and drives the joints there at most 0.02 rad per 20 Hz control step (duration_s does not apply); if no IK solution exists nothing moves and the result says so

notes: Grasping is sticky: when the gripper closes, an object a finger touches is attached, and it is released when the gripper opens. The gripper value in the state is the command in force; gripper_opening_m is the measured opening (it stays above the closed value when closed on something). Joint efforts (panda_joint1_effort ...) in proprio_now grow when the arm pushes on something. The episode ends by itself when the goal has held for 10 consecutive control steps.
